conviction_note: A pre-revenue biotech whose last seven prints moved a median 0.96% (Q2's EPS beat was sold), so the quarter's numbers barely matter. The release lands on a stock that went round trip: +36% on maintenance data on 9/22, a $35 offering on 9/24, then down to $24.98, 29% below the deal price, with 21% of float short and calls bid (skew -6.8). That gives a mild upside lean, p_up 55. abs_move is 5.0, below the 6.46% implied move because of the damped print history and above the median because Lilly's 10-29 bmo print sits inside the window. The findings sum to +0.4 and the scaled number is +0.5; the two agree.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$1.06 (normalized -$1.0602, 24/7 Wall St, https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/25/why-viking-therapeutics-oral-obesity-strategy-will-be-a-make-or-break-focus-on-oct-28/) against -$1.00 from 9 analysts (Earnings Whispers aggregator snippet, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/VKTX). Two sources that disagree, so the bar is disputed and the EPS finding is capped at small. Revenue bar is $0. The stock does not trade on EPS; it trades on pipeline timing and cash. My -5% read is an inference: R&D rises with VANQUISH fully enrolled and SUNRISE started, from Q2's $115.8m R&D and -$1.10 EPS (https://ir.vikingtherapeutics.com/2026-07-29-Viking-Therapeutics-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Provides-Corporate-Update).
positioning_check: Short interest 25,538,849 shares, 21.41% of float, 4.4 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 record date (FINRA, published 2026-10-26), down 1.48% from 25.92m on 9/30 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/VKTX/short-interest). In mid-2026 it was about 19% of float at 10-13 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/vktx/short-interest). Days to cover fell because volume rose after the offering. Baseline skew_25d is -6.77 vol points (calls over puts, 'upside paid') and put/call OI is 0.32. Spot is 3.16% above the 52-week low, -23.4% over 20 days and -5.3% over 5 days. The book is crowded short and options lean up, so any negative is shrunk.

findings.finding: The stock is $24.98, 29% below the $35.00 price of the upsized offering that priced 2026-09-24 (7,857,143 shares plus a $225m 2.00% 2032 convert, conversion about $50.75). It has given back all of the +36% maintenance-data jump of 9/22 and more, so the post-deal holders are underwater going into the first print after the raise. At the same time 21.4% of float is short and the options skew pays for upside (-6.77). Any print that is not negative meets a book positioned for down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior post-offering print to compare. The name's earnings reactions run median 0.96% and max 7.96% (+7.96% Oct 2025, +6.8% Feb 2026, two of three up moves at the Q3/Q4 prints). Positioning-driven up moves in this name came on data, not on the quarterly numbers.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown has a known cause: dilution and a discounted deal, plus sector rotation toward Lilly. It is not hidden information, which is why this is sized small. If the market had already turned, short interest would have dropped after the deal; instead it held at 25.5m shares, roughly flat with 9/30. The skew shows options traders are already leaning up, so part of this is priced.
findings.independence: Offering terms from the FWP and 424B5 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001607678/000121390026102798/ea0306515-fwp_viking.htm; https://finviz.com/news/395087/viking-therapeutics-prices-upsized-500-million-offering-of-common-stock-and-convertible-senior-notes). The 41% one-month fall and the $24.40 close on 10/23 come from 24/7 Wall St (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/25/why-viking-therapeutics-oral-obesity-strategy-will-be-a-make-or-break-focus-on-oct-28/). Separate sources, but one theme.

findings.finding: Q3 should be the first balance sheet with the September raise in it. That is $502m cash at 6/30 plus about $548m net proceeds (reported net when the deal closed, greenshoes included) less a Q3 burn of roughly $130-140m, so about $0.9bn at 9/30. 24/7 Wall St says the raise extends funding into 2028. The money pays for VANQUISH-1/2 (about 5,500 patients, fully enrolled) and SUNRISE-1/2 (oral Phase 3, started 10/14), so the use of funds is corroborated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The financing day itself moved the stock -12 to -15% on 9/24 and about -7% more on 9/28 (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/24/heres-why-viking-therapeutics-shares-slumped-today/). No print-day cash reaction is on record.
findings.why_not_priced: The proceeds are public, so most of this is priced. What is new is a confirmed 9/30 cash figure, and possibly a stated runway, on a stock whose market cap (about $3bn on roughly 125m shares) is only about 3x pro forma cash. If the market had fully credited the cash, the stock would not be sitting at its 52-week low.
findings.independence: Net proceeds of about $548m are reported in the deal-closing coverage summarised in a Yahoo article (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/vktx-stock-logs-3-day-030252376.html). The 'into 2028' runway comes from 24/7 Wall St (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/25/why-viking-therapeutics-oral-obesity-strategy-will-be-a-make-or-break-focus-on-oct-28/). The cash figure and the deal are separate documents.

findings.finding: Eli Lilly reports Q3 2026 before the open on 2026-10-29, inside this window, with a 10:00 ET call (company-confirmed in its 10/15 release). Lilly comes in up more than 18% year to date, with Q2 Mounjaro sales +91%. Its retatrutide head-to-head results were released the morning of 10/28. The obesity-sector read-through therefore hits VKTX in the same session it digests its own print, and the direction is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No documented VKTX reaction to a Lilly print in this file. Novo's misses and Lilly's beats in 2026 came alongside a VKTX slide, but the cause was not established.
findings.why_not_priced: It has not happened yet. This adds variance, not a known direction: strong Lilly obesity numbers can be read as category validation or as more competition for VK2735. It is filed at zero size so the judges can see the second catalyst in the window.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-28, before the open, Lilly's retatrutide beat Ozempic 2mg head-to-head in type 2 diabetes (TRANSCEND-T2D-2, 1,298 patients, 80 weeks: A1C -2.2 vs -1.8 points, weight loss about 44-47 lb vs 21 lb). Lilly plans to file retatrutide in obesity in early 2027. That raises the efficacy bar VK2735 (GLP-1/GIP dual) will be compared against when VANQUISH reads out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No documented VKTX reaction to retatrutide headlines in this file.
findings.why_not_priced: It was released pre-market on the event day, so most of it is in the 10/28 close the trade enters at. It can come back on the Viking call if analysts ask about positioning against triple agonists. Sized small and negative for that reason. The crowded short limits it.
findings.independence: None from a different source. This is industry transmission that Viking has not confirmed.

findings.finding: Viking corrected its 2026-10-06 release: the oral maintenance study (Part 2, about 195 adults, readout in 2027) tests daily oral dosing, not weekly oral doses, after 21 weeks of weekly subcutaneous induction. The 'weekly oral' option implied by the original wording does not exist in the trial.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on record. The stock fell about 17% in the month to mid-October, which spans this correction.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the correction is weeks old and noted at the bottom of the company's own 10/14 release. It could come up on the call as a question about oral maintenance strategy. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: The company's 10/14 SUNRISE release carries the correction note (https://ir.vikingtherapeutics.com/2026-10-14-Viking-Therapeutics-Announces-Initiation-of-VK2735-Oral-Phase-3-Clinical-Program-in-Patients-with-Obesity).

findings.finding: The reported-quarter line does not move this name. Q2 2026 beat (-$1.10 vs -$1.21 consensus, the first beat in six reports) and the stock still fell (-0.96% close to close in the baseline, -4.14% the next day per 24/7 Wall St). Q3 R&D should rise from $115.8m as both VANQUISH trials are fully enrolled and SUNRISE starts, so EPS is more likely to land a little below the disputed -$1.00 to -$1.06 bar than above it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last seven prints: -0.96, -0.48, +6.80, +7.96, +0.30, -0.50, -6.09; median absolute 0.96%. A beat was sold in Q2 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Not an edge. It is filed so the judges can see the EPS line is a non-factor on a disputed bar, capped at zero.
findings.independence: Q2 figures from the company release (https://ir.vikingtherapeutics.com/2026-07-29-Viking-Therapeutics-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Provides-Corporate-Update).

outside_window.finding: VANQUISH-1/2 78-week readouts: both trials are fully enrolled, so readout is plausibly 2027. No date is given in the 7/29 or 10/14 releases. A timing statement on the call would land in the window; the data itself lands well outside it.
Oral maintenance study Part 2 (about 195 adults) results expected in 2027.

rejected_candidates.detail: This is a model output, not a fact about the print. A DCF on a pre-revenue Phase 3 obesity asset is contradicted by the sell-side target range ($38-$114, consensus about $95 per TIKR). Kept out as non-evidence.

baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the negative skew (calls bid) and cuts with the deep drawdown: the run-up is dilution, not priced disappointment, and the crowded short points up. The quarter's line carries little, so I moved p_up only to 55 and not further.
lessons_applied: Lessons 5 and 7: positioning alone is not a catalyst, and here the drawdown has a documented cause (the discounted $35 offering). The crowded-short/round-trip finding went from +1.0 to +0.6; it is kept, not dropped, because the core requires filing it.

Lesson 4: I asked what the September financing buys. It funds VANQUISH-1/2 and SUNRISE, corroborated by the 10/14 trial initiation, so the financing finding stays positive and small at +0.3, unchanged.
Lessons 1 and 6: the EPS bar is disputed (-1.00 vs -1.06) and the Q2 beat was sold, so the reported-quarter finding stays at 0 and print_vs_bar is low-confidence. Unchanged.
abs_move_pct 5.0 and p_up 55 unchanged; impact sum moved from +0.8 to +0.4.
